notes: Inbound from product — built native ticket automation, looking to augment with LLM for summarization + action extraction.
Primary ask: hosted API (self-serve) so product team can iterate quickly; low-friction onboarding important.
Workloads: live support assistant (chat), end-of-conversation ticket summarization (1-3 paragraphs), structured action extraction to update their ticketing DB.
Latency/throughput targets: median <200ms for agent-facing chat; summarization acceptable up to 800ms for batch jobs; bulk nightly summarization ~5000 tickets/hr target for later stage.
Cost sensitivity: high — SMB. Prefer small/efficient models (7B/13B quantized) and aggressive token controls. Wants per-token visibility in billing.
Model preferences: open models ok (for hosted API) — want guidance on quantized variants. Experimenting with a smaller LLM plus heuristic post-processing.
Routing/fallback: wants automatic fallback to cheaper model on cost threshold or rate limits; also ability to pin model per route.
Security/compliance: SSO needed for admin console; audit logs for every API call; retention policy: 30d by default, option to auto-delete user-submitted content after 30d.
Tool-calling: MUST have function/tool calling so model can emit structured JSON to trigger ticket updates (status, assignee, tags). Example provided in Drive prompt kit.
Structured output: strict JSON schema required — example in Drive (structured_ticket_v2.json). Will fail fast on malformed output.
Customer quote from 2026-02-15 call: "We want a drop-in hosted API — no infra for us. If onboarding is quick and costs are predictable we'll convert to paid after 2-week pilot."
Pilot plan: 2-week self-serve trial using hosted API keys + sample prompt set; run on sandbox tickets from staging environment (PII scrubbed).
Security review: sent short security questionnaire 2026-03-04; ask for SOC2 summary + data deletion API details.
Notes from demo request: engineer lead (CTO) prefers quickstart with examples for tool-calling and examples of structured-output validation code (node/python).
Internal: AE to follow up with hosted API quickstart link + sample billing view; SE to prepare small demo repo showing function calling -> create ticket flow.
Risks: budget small; if early pilot shows >$0.015/token equivalent they will switch to smaller model or self-host alternatives.
Success metric for pilot: reduce average handle time by 20% and achieve >=85% accurate action extraction for automation flows.
Jira references: forwarded logs to eng team — SUPPORT-119 (pilot onboarding), SUPPORT-125 (security questionnaire follow-up).
